details: European Central Bank (ECB) Vice President Luis de Guindos stated that private credit, elevated market valuations, and loose fiscal policies in some countries pose significant risks to financial stability. He also urged caution on interest rate adjustments amidst geopolitical uncertainty, even as inflation in the Eurozone recently climbed to 2.6%.
title: ECB Warns of Risks from Private Credit and High Valuations

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) projects global public debt to reach 99% of world GDP by 2028, potentially surging to 121% under stress scenarios. The IMF also issued a stark warning regarding the US economy, noting its national debt is on track to exceed 125% this year. These rising debt levels signal fiscal unsustainability and potential future economic strain.
title: IMF Warns on Unsustainable Global and US Debt Levels

details: Bitcoin climbed past $78,000, buoyed by the extension of a US-Iran ceasefire, which eased geopolitical tensions. Further fueling the rally was significant institutional demand, including a reported $2.5 billion Bitcoin acquisition by Strategy Inc. Analysts highlight Bitcoin's growing role as both a risk asset and a hedge against geopolitical instability.
title: Bitcoin Surges Above $78K Amid Iran Truce and Strong Inflows
